subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become the permanent public Plugin SDK/runtime contract for plugins reacting to externally observed session lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The Teams fix needs a generic owner-coordinated session rotation seam, but repository policy makes new Plugin SDK surface and its long-term compatibility semantics an explicit human ownership decision.

options.title: Approve the narrow public contract
options.body: Accept this generic API with its ownership checks, atomic handoff, stale-signal guards, and documented replacement-row semantics.

options.title: Keep the operation internal
options.body: Retain the Teams fix but redesign the core integration so no new third-party Plugin SDK promise is created.

options.title: Pause the lifecycle reset
options.body: Hold this PR if plugins should not initiate externally driven session rotation at all.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Accept this generic API with its ownership checks, atomic handoff, stale-signal guards, and documented replacement-row semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the personal-chat scope refinement and is the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-cutting API choice.
